issue: \captionof{figure}{End-to-end architecture and tensor flow of MobilePIXORNeXt. Unordered 3D LiDAR point clouds pass through the parameter-free Strata-BEV14 rasterizer into a 14-channel statistical BEV tensor   without learned pillar encoders. ConvNeXt-style stages with parameter-free Block-SimAM attention extract multi-scale features. A top-down Scale-Gated Feature Pyramid Network (SG-FPN) fuses them into a 32-channel shared representation at stride 4 ( ). Decoupled GroupedHeader towers process Car and Pedestrian/Cyclist categories independently. Solid arrows show the feedforward inference path. Dashed arrows show training-only Oriented Geometric Alignment (OGA), IoU-Aware Quality Alignment (IQA), and Temperature-Softmax Bounded Uncertainty Weighting (T-SBUW).}

Channels 4--7 encode normalized maximum elevation  , mean elevation  , elevation span  , and sample standard deviation  . Channels 8--9 encode maximum and mean reflectance intensity.
